bm25_word.label: BM25 (word)
bm25_word.desc: Classic word-level lexical search. A baseline that struggles with Luxembourgish spelling variation.

bm25_char.label: BM25 (char 3–5-gram)
bm25_char.desc: Lexical search over character n-grams. Matches sub-word fragments, so it is robust to spelling variation.

hybrid_rrf_char.label: Hybrid RRF (char)
hybrid_rrf_char.desc: Combines character-BM25 and dense results by reciprocal-rank fusion.

hybrid_w_char.label: Hybrid weighted (char)
hybrid_w_char.desc: Weighted mix of character-BM25 and dense retrieval. The strongest retriever on this corpus.

retrieve_direct_fact.label: Retrieve: direct fact
retrieve_direct_fact.desc: The answer is stated directly in the text (PIRLS: retrieve explicitly stated information).

inferential_reasoning.label: Inferential reasoning
inferential_reasoning.desc: The answer requires combining clues to make a straightforward inference (PIRLS).

interpretive_comprehension.label: Interpretive comprehension
interpretive_comprehension.desc: The answer requires interpreting and integrating ideas across the text (PIRLS).

evaluative_reasoning.label: Evaluative reasoning
evaluative_reasoning.desc: The answer requires evaluating content, language, or the author's choices (PIRLS).

closed_book.label: Closed-book
closed_book.desc: The model answers from its own parameters, with no text provided. A contamination/calibration control.

full_text_oracle.label: Full-text oracle
full_text_oracle.desc: The model is given the entire correct source text. Removes retrieval failure; an upper bound.

rag_text_restricted.label: RAG (text-restricted)
rag_text_restricted.desc: Retrieval is limited to chunks from the correct source text, then the model answers.

rag_open_corpus.label: RAG (open-corpus)
rag_open_corpus.desc: Retrieval runs over all 16 texts, so it can surface passages from the wrong story. The hardest, most realistic setting.

text_restricted.label: Text-restricted
text_restricted.desc: Retrieval scope: search only within the current text.

open_corpus.label: Open-corpus
open_corpus.desc: Retrieval scope: search across the whole 16-text corpus.

critical_only.label: Critical only
critical_only.desc: The retriever surfaced the evidence for the correct answer, and no distractor.

both.label: Critical + distractor
both.desc: The retriever surfaced both the correct evidence and a distractor. Accuracy is highest here (0.80).

distractor_only.label: Distractor only
distractor_only.desc: The retriever surfaced a distractor but missed the correct evidence. The trap: accuracy falls.

neither.label: Neither
neither.desc: The retriever surfaced neither the correct evidence nor a distractor. Accuracy is lowest (0.48).

1.label: Surface patterns
1.desc: Spelling and morphology cues (n-rule, false friends). Fine-tuned encoders win clearly.

2.label: Discourse / syntax
2.desc: Coreference and clause structure. Mixed results, dependent on the model's pretraining.

3.label: World knowledge
3.desc: Loanwords and rare/archaic vocabulary. Large LLMs keep an edge over small encoders.

ortho-phono-diverge.label: Ortho-phono divergence
ortho-phono-diverge.desc: A word whose spelling diverges from its pronunciation, or that is spelled inconsistently.

morph-n-rule.label: n-rule (Eifeler Regel)
morph-n-rule.desc: The Eifeler Regel: final -n is dropped or kept depending on the next sound. A hallmark Luxembourgish spelling rule.

lex-false-friend.label: False friend
lex-false-friend.desc: A word that looks like a German or French word but means something different.

syn-verb-sep.label: Separable verb
syn-verb-sep.desc: A verb whose prefix detaches and moves elsewhere in the clause.

syn-verb-final.label: Verb-final clause
syn-verb-final.desc: A subordinate clause with the finite verb at the end (Germanic word order).

disc-coref-ambig.label: Ambiguous coreference
disc-coref-ambig.desc: A pronoun or reference whose antecedent is not obvious.

lex-rare-zls.label: Rare/archaic word
lex-rare-zls.desc: A rare, dialectal, or archaic Luxembourgish word.

lex-idiom-zls.label: Idiom
lex-idiom-zls.desc: A Luxembourgish idiom. Excluded from training: too few examples.

syn-embedded.label: Embedded clause
syn-embedded.desc: A deeply embedded clause. Excluded from training: too few examples.

items.label: Orthographic divergence / n-rule
items.note: (regime 1): recovered by the encoders, missed by the LLMs.

items.label: French loanwords
items.note: (regime 3, e.g. Café, Supermarché, Gare): recovered by the LLMs, missed by the encoders.
